parsed.rationale: All three records — `PlaylistSectionHeader` (PlaylistView.swift:215), `TextRowView` (TextRowView.swift:14), and `FittingText` (InfoDetailView.swift:232) — are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same package (`app:iOS`) with identical structural shape (shared_field_count: 2, no differing slots). No restraint markers are present on any record. The three aliases appear to be independent redeclarations of the same underlying SwiftUI view pattern, differing only in name. Consolidating them into a single canonical declaration (retaining the most semantically general name, `FittingText`) and replacing the other two with either a re-export alias or direct usage of `FittingText` eliminates the duplication without crossing package boundaries.
